influences.name: Miles Davis
influences.context: Warren Haynes' all-time favorite group is the second great Miles Davis Quintet with Wayne Shorter, Herbie Hancock, Tony Williams and Ron Carter... Haynes' enthusiasm is driven less by the instrumentation than by the intent... He developed his own musical philosophy around it.

influences.name: Van Morrison
influences.context: You can trace that back to a lot of rock bands from late '60s and early '70s who took that approach to varying degrees. If you listen to Van Morrison's Astral Weeks, that's what that is in its own way.
